items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: The transcript contains only the INTERVIEWER mentioning Earl Hines in relation to a third party ('Archey'). The INTERVIEWEE (Benny Waters) does not speak or respond to this specific mention, so no personal relationship between Benny Waters and Earl Hines is established in the text.

ctx.x: At the end of the three weeks in Switzerland Archey said the band wasn't goin' back to Ryan's, that they're be no gig if he went back -
He said he was going to join - which he did, he joined Earl Hines in the, he joined Earl Hines in the, in San Francisco at some club out there that they were working.
Sure, yeah, Earl was there for years -
